svg.title: LoomFlow: the Fleet overview release
svg.desc: A 32-second loop of PR 157. Sync the feature with master. GPT 6.1 Sol and Sonnet 5.5 review in parallel. One major keyboard-focus defect is fixed and tested. Both second reviews have no findings. All four CI checks pass. One merge gate merges commit 8ce2e8e to master. Timing is compressed.
svg.metadata: Run: https://github.com/breakbadsp/triangulator/pull/157. Visual reference: https://bun.sh/blog/bun-in-rust#compiler-errors-as-a-work-queue. Original diagram; timing is illustrative, not a recording.

g.text: Sync the complete feature with master.
PR #157 opens. The merge has no conflicts.
Two independent reviews. One major finding.
Reviewer A finds keyboard focus loss when tiles reorder.
Reviewer B: no findings · merge stays blocked
Reproduce. Add a regression test. Restore focus.
The test fails before the fix and passes after it.
adce073 · Chromium proof · make check passes
Both reviewers check the fix and its callers.
Reviewer A: no findings. Reviewer B: no findings.
0 open findings · no third review round
All four checks pass on the reviewed commit.
CI validates adce073 combined with the master base.
Reuse passing coverage · no duplicate full test run
One merge gate checks the release conditions.
Expected head. Clean worktree. Passing checks. Mergeable.
One major defect fixed. Both final reviews are clear.
One major defect fixed. Both final reviews are clear.

svg.text: 2 review rounds maximum · 1 merge gate · no open blocker or major at merge
